en: Next to or in a line with something; or moving forward.
ex: We walked along the beach at sunset.
我們在日落時沿著海灘散步。

en: Before now or before a particular time.
ex: I have already finished my homework.
我已經寫完功課了。

en: In addition; too.
ex: She speaks English and also French.
她會說英語，也會說法語。

en: Used to introduce a fact that is surprising or opposite to the main idea.
ex: Although it was raining, we went out.
雖然下著雨，我們還是出門了。

en: At all times; every time.
ex: He is always on time for class.
他上課總是準時。

en: The form of 'be' used with 'I'; or 'a.m.' means before noon.
ex: I am a student at this school.
我是這所學校的學生。

en: Used to join words, phrases or sentences.
ex: I like tea and coffee.
我喜歡茶和咖啡。

en: Feeling strong displeasure toward someone or something.
ex: She was angry because he forgot her birthday.
她很生氣，因為他忘了她的生日。

en: A living thing that can move and feel, such as a dog, bird or fish.
ex: The zoo has many kinds of animals.
動物園裡有很多種動物。

en: One more of the same kind; or a different one.
ex: Would you like another cup of coffee?
你想再來一杯咖啡嗎？

en: Something you say or write in reply to a question; or the solution to a problem.
ex: Can you answer this question?
你能回答這個問題嗎？

en: A very small insect that lives in large groups and works hard.
ex: The ants carried food back to their nest.
螞蟻把食物搬回牠們的巢。

en: One or some, no matter which; used in questions and negatives.
ex: Do you have any questions?
你有任何問題嗎？

en: Any person; or an important person.
ex: Is anyone home?
有人在家嗎？

en: Any thing, no matter what.
ex: Would you like anything to drink?
你想喝點什麼嗎？

en: A set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building.
ex: They live in a small apartment in the city.
他們住在市區的一間小公寓裡。

en: To come into sight; or to seem to be something.
ex: A rainbow appeared after the rain.
雨後出現了一道彩虹。

en: A round fruit with red, green or yellow skin that grows on trees.
ex: I eat an apple every morning.
我每天早上吃一顆蘋果。

en: A part of a place, country or space; or the size of a flat surface.
ex: This area is famous for its beautiful lakes.
這個地區以美麗的湖泊聞名。

en: The part of the body between the shoulder and the hand; or to give someone weapons.
ex: He broke his arm when he fell off the bike.
他從腳踏車上摔下來，摔斷了手臂。

en: On every side of something; or in many places; or approximately.
ex: We looked around the shop but bought nothing.
我們在店裡四處看看，卻什麼也沒買。

en: To get to a place, especially at the end of a journey.
ex: The train arrives at six o'clock.
火車六點抵達。

en: The use of imagination to make things such as paintings, music or sculpture; or a skill.
ex: She is studying art at university.
她在大學主修藝術。

en: Used to say how something is done or what role something has; or in comparisons; or because.
ex: She works as a teacher in a primary school.
她在小學擔任老師。

en: To say something to get information; or to request something.
ex: May I ask you a question?
我可以問你一個問題嗎？

en: Used to show a place, time or direction.
ex: I will meet you at the station at noon.
我中午在車站和你碰面。

en: To use violence against someone; or to criticize someone strongly; or an act of violence.
ex: The dog attacked the postman.
狗攻擊了郵差。

en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.
ex: My aunt lives in the countryside.
我的阿姨住在鄉下。

en: To or at a distance from a place; not present.
ex: He ran away when he saw the dog.
他看到狗就跑開了。

en: A very young child who cannot yet walk or talk.
ex: The baby is sleeping in her crib.
寶寶正睡在嬰兒床裡。

en: The part of something behind the front; or to support someone; or to return.
ex: He sat in the back of the classroom.
他坐在教室後面。

en: Not good; of poor quality; harmful or unpleasant.
ex: The weather was bad, so we stayed home.
天氣很糟，所以我們待在家裡。

en: A container made of paper, plastic or cloth for carrying things.
ex: She put the books in her bag.
她把書放進袋子裡。

en: A round object used in games and sports; or a formal party with dancing.
ex: The children are playing with a ball in the park.
孩子們在公園裡玩球。

en: A long, curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft white inside.
ex: He peeled a banana and ate it.
他剝了一根香蕉吃掉。

en: A group of musicians who play together; or a narrow strip of material.
ex: My brother plays guitar in a band.
我哥哥在樂團裡彈吉他。

en: A place where people keep their money; or the land along the side of a river.
ex: I need to go to the bank to get some cash.
我需要去銀行領些現金。

en: A ball game played by two teams, in which players hit the ball with a bat and run around bases.
ex: Baseball is very popular in Taiwan.
棒球在台灣非常受歡迎。

en: A container made of strips of wood or plastic used for carrying things.
ex: She carried a basket of apples to the market.
她提著一籃蘋果去市場。

en: A game in which two teams try to throw a ball through a high net.
ex: My friends and I play basketball every weekend.
我和朋友們每個週末都打籃球。
